name: Listening Level
description: Total number of hours listened(lifetime listen, across all devices).

name: Marathoner
description: Number of hours listened in one session.

name: Repeat Listener
description: Number of times the same book has been completed.
reward: You've listened to the same audiobook 20 times!

name: Weekend Warrior
description: Number of hours listened during the weekend.
reward: You've listened 24 hours over a single weekend!

name: Night Owl
description: Time listened at night, between 10pm and 6am.
reward: You've listened 8 hours straight at night!

name: High Noon
description: Time listened during lunch time, i.e. between 11am and 2pm.

name: Mount Everest
description: Length of longest book listened to from start to finish, in hours.
reward: You finished an audiobook that's longer than 30 hours!

name: Dabbler
description: Number of books of distinct genres completed
reward: You've listened to audiobooks in at least 5 different genres!

name: 7-day stretch
description: Number of distinct books completed in a single week.
reward: You finished 5 audiobooks in a single week!

name: Social Butterfly
description: Number of times a user shares an activity though Facebook, Twitter, or Email.
reward: You shared your listening habits on social media 5 times!

name: Alexa
description: Number of distinct books listened to on Alexa
reward: You've listened to 1 audiobook on Alexa!

name: The Stack
description: Number of books in the library, excluding subscriptions and book parts.
reward: You've collected 50 audiobooks in your Library!

name: Nibbler
description: Number of books listened to (not necessarily completed) in one day.
reward: You listened to 3 audiobooks in 1 day!

name: Watchtower
description: Number of times Statistics screen has been visited.
